description: Configurable structural ranges and best-practice guidance for reusable blog and social-media post templates.

deferred_profiles.social_media: Preserved for a later, independently designed social-media template milestone.

title.best_practice: Use one concise, descriptive H1 that reflects the article's central reader question and outcome.

subtitles.best_practice: Use descriptive H2 headings based on genuine reader sub-questions. Give each section a direct answer before adding context, evidence, or examples.

body.best_practice: Use this range as an editorial depth target. Build a focused article with an early key takeaway, original value, evidence, practical guidance, and a clear next step.

tags.best_practice: Provide exactly ten specific, descriptive tags that reflect the article's topic, audience, concepts, and relevant product domain.

authoring_inputs: Define the target audience, their concrete question or problem, and the intended reader outcome.
Gather credible primary sources, first-hand experience, original data, testing, or practical examples.
Provide product or site context when a relevant internal link or example supports the reader's next step.
Identify the author and factual reviewer when this information is available.
recommended_article_flow: State a direct answer or key takeaway near the beginning.
Use a table of contents when it improves navigation across the article's sections.
Develop question-led sections that provide useful depth and original value.
Support material factual claims with reliable sources and distinguish facts, opinions, assumptions, and uncertainty.
Include practical examples, implementation steps, comparisons, or decision guidance.
Add a focused FAQ when genuine follow-up questions improve the article.
Connect readers to relevant internal resources with concise, descriptive anchor text.
quality_and_search: Create people-first content that provides a complete, useful answer for the intended audience.
Make expertise visible through original work, transparent authorship, careful sourcing, and meaningful updates.
Use concise, descriptive language in the title, headings, tags, and internal links.
Keep important information available as accessible text and support it with relevant images or video when they improve understanding.
Use structured data that accurately represents visible content and an applicable Search feature.
publishing_handoff: Map the main title to a concise HTML title and a single visually distinct H1.
Provide a descriptive meta description, semantic heading hierarchy, and crawlable internal links.
Include accurate Article structured data, author information, relevant accessible images, and deliberate crawl/index settings.
